owner_objective: Independently prove the complete locally authenticated Binance Spot lifecycle for the controlled 1x50-USDC trial and subsequent normal Live: WAITING_SIGNAL -> fresh closed-1h canonical signal -> durable idempotent MARKET BUY -> actual fill query -> bot-owned position -> canonical strategy exit -> durable MARKET SELL -> fill query -> account/order reconciliation -> COMPLETED -> production Live eligibility. Verify restart/timeout/partial-fill/dust/error behavior and Paper/Backtest strategy parity. Cloud remains key-free/order-free and must never claim a real Binance fill.

acceptance.waiting_signal: Arming performs a fresh authenticated account/baseline preflight but never submits an old signal. Only a fresh valid closed-1h signal from the ten canonical USDC markets may reserve the one 50-USDC BUY.
acceptance.real_submit_boundary: The bound production transport must POST /api/v3/order type=MARKET with quoteOrderQty=50.00 for BUY and explicit bot-owned base quantity for SELL, using durable clientOrderId and no automatic retry of ambiguous submissions.
acceptance.buy_fill: ACK alone is never treated as fill. Order state and myTrades fills must be queried and persisted; partial/unknown/incomplete fill details remain unsettled.
acceptance.ownership: Only quantity proven from Hixton's own persisted BUY fills may be sold. Existing Binance holdings remain baseline-only.
acceptance.exit: After an owned entry, canonical strategy exit rules continue even if new entries/release are disabled. The SELL must be rounded down only to current Binance step size and may not exceed owned quantity.
acceptance.completion: A SELL fill alone is insufficient. Trial reaches COMPLETED only after fresh account reconciliation proves no open orders, no locked balances, expected balances and no tradable residual; otherwise NEEDS_REVIEW/AWAITING_RECONCILIATION persists.
acceptance.recovery: Restart, network timeout, ambiguous Binance response, duplicate advance, partial fill and process interruption may not create a duplicate BUY/SELL. Submitted or uncertain history is reconciled, never reset as a new entitlement.
acceptance.parity: Trial and production Live must bind the same canonical StrategyDefinition/coin profiles/closed-candle semantics as current V6 backtest/Paper. Real fills/fees/slippage may differ from modeled backtests and no identical PnL is claimed.
acceptance.production: Normal budget-controlled Live remains disabled until the 1x50 BUY+SELL roundtrip is fully reconciled; normal Live must preserve the same ownership, pre-submit, reconciliation and exit-safety principles.
acceptance.cloud_boundary: No cloud/agent job may read private Binance credentials or place real/testnet orders. A real Binance fill can only be proven locally by authenticated order/fill/reconciliation evidence.

diagnostic_chain: fresh authenticated preflight and stable baseline
ACK -> order query -> myTrades fill persistence
bot-owned quantity calculation including base-asset fees
canonical strategy exit while entries may be disabled
Binance SELL explicit owned base quantity and filter rounding
SELL fill details and residual/dust validation

A01.objective: Trace docs, UI text and code for the complete 1x50 BUY->SELL->reconciliation lifecycle. Identify any wording that implies a fill/completion before Binance evidence exists or any obsolete gate.

A02.objective: Prove strategy parity: the trial and production Live consume the same canonical ten-coin StrategyDefinition, coin profiles, closed-1h semantics, entry ranking and exit rules as current Backtest/Paper. Exercise fresh-signal-only and missed-exit/current-reference behavior.

A03.objective: Audit durable state, account baseline, bot-owned ledger, restart recovery and every trial transition WAITING_SIGNAL->ENTRY_PENDING->OPEN->EXIT_PENDING->AWAITING_RECONCILIATION->COMPLETED/NEEDS_REVIEW. Prove foreign holdings cannot be sold.

A04.objective: Run the real Chromium operator flow through credentials/status, automatic preflight on arm, WAITING_SIGNAL, visible BUY/OPEN/EXIT/reconciliation states under fake exchange evidence, and Live enable only after COMPLETED. Verify shipped bundle freshness.

A05.objective: Audit 24/7 scheduler, closed-bar wake-up, runtime HEALTHY/DEGRADED handling, source/version drift and process restart. Prove an OPEN owned position remains exit-capable and is not stranded by entry-disable/release changes.

A06.objective: Execute full integration/failure matrix with fake authenticated exchange: successful BUY+SELL, timeout after accepted BUY, timeout after accepted SELL, partial fills, missing fill details, restart between reservation/submit/query, duplicate calls, definitive rejection, API/network errors, residual quantity and reconciliation mismatch. No duplicate order may occur.

A07.objective: Audit the concrete Binance Spot adapter and current official API requirements: signed POST /api/v3/order MARKET BUY quoteOrderQty, MARKET SELL quantity, origClientOrderId lookup, myTrades fill lookup, permissions, filters, precision, account/openOrders snapshot. No private credential use in cloud.

A08.objective: Audit all safety/risk/capital gates immediately before entry and exit. Confirm HEALTHY/release/source/settings gates block new BUY safely but never strand a proven bot-owned exit; verify minQty/stepSize/dust and 50-USDC exact budget.

A09.objective: Independently QA the exact commit after A10. Require complete evidence for the full simulated roundtrip, real Chromium, full tests, strategy parity, idempotency/restart, exit/reconciliation and no cloud-real-fill overclaim.

A10.objective: Synthesize the exact blocker chain from WAITING_SIGNAL to COMPLETED and normal Live. Reject PASS if BUY can be sent but SELL/reconciliation/restart/ownership proof is incomplete; route every defect to a named specialist.

A11.objective: Govern the entire round. Reject stale/mixed commits, mocked-as-real claims, missing real-browser evidence, duplicate-submit risk, foreign-balance liquidation risk, or any statement that cloud proved a real Binance fill.

owner_context.operator_statement: API key/secret are stored locally; UI says controlled 1x50 trial armed, baseline/account checks passed, no order sent yet.
operator_questions: Will a real Binance Spot order actually be submitted when a fresh valid signal occurs?
Will the bot later close that exact bot-owned position automatically instead of leaving it open indefinitely?
Does the real execution use the same strategy/exit logic as the backtests, subject to real market fills/fees/slippage?
Can restarts, timeouts, partial fills, dust, account changes or disabled entries strand or duplicate the position?
owner_context.required_local_boundary: Cloud may prove code and simulated exchange behavior only. Actual real-order/fill proof must come from the local authenticated runtime and must include Binance order/fill IDs plus reconciliation, without exposing API key/secret.
